description: Real E-AC-3 files: joint object coding (Dolby Atmos) test files from Dolby's Dolby Digital Plus Online Delivery Kit v1.4.1, and two E-AC-3 files with the adaptive hybrid transform from the FFmpeg sample archive. None may be redistributed here, so they are downloaded and checked against their SHA-256 rather than committed. Per file: what the analyzer, ffprobe and MediaInfo must report, and the warnings the analyzer reports ("findings"; the codes of every finding that is not an info).

dolby.terms: © 2018 Dolby Laboratories, Inc. All rights reserved. Dolby serves the test signals publicly for testing playback products. They are not redistributed here: CI downloads them at the pinned SHA-256 and the repository does not hold them.

ffmpeg.terms: The FFmpeg sample archive's 00-README: "You are free to download any samples you want". They are downloaded and checked, not committed.
